title: Bound on reachable codes
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s,u$ be natural numbers. If $u$ is reachable from the initial configuration code by zero or more encoded steps within the $s$-window, then $u<2^{K(N)(s+\ell(|x|)+1)}$, where $K(N)$ is the fixed code-length parameter of $N$ and $\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
